title: Sharran Wolf
html:

Sharran Wolf is a wolf form applied to nearby Sharran Novices when Viconia DeVir casts  Mapped Terror: Wolves. Viconia herself will transform into a stronger version of this form.

Combat

The ability scores and passive features of this form are the same as a  Wolf Companion at level 7, though it has different actions. This also means this form is considerably stronger on Explorer difficulty since it benefits from buffs normally intended for the party's wolf companions.

When the wolf's hit points are depleted, the polymorphed Sharran Novice reverts to humanoid form just like a normal  Wild Shape.
